title: Grandchild saying thank you
description: A real grandchild rings to say thanks for a birthday card and to plan Sunday lunch.

lines.text: Hello sweetheart, what a lovely surprise.
Just ringing to say thank you for the birthday card. It made me smile.
Are we still on for Sunday lunch?
Of course. I'm making a roast.
Brilliant. I'll pick you up at twelve, and I'll bring the dog.
Love you, Gran. See you on Sunday.
